messages:
rachel: Kicking off follow-up for OrionHealth postmortem (INC-2026-0523). Focus: VPC peering blackholing + on-prem firewall resets causing tenant isolation. Need owners + realistic deadlines.
ops-bot: Incident INC-2026-0523 recorded. Severity P2. Link: https://redwood.internal/incidents/INC-2026-0523
diego: Short summary: customer had an older ASA that dropped half-open sessions under high SYN rates. Resulting BGP flaps + our tag-enforcement logic pruned routes -> isolation.
nia: runtime note: the tag-enforcement compensator runs aggressively during backlog spikes. It throttles, but still issues deletion ops that lead to transient route loss.
rachel: Proposed action items: 1) Diego -> customer mitigation + config window to test relaxed BGP timers (due 2026-05-03). 2) Nia -> implement "grace period" in tag-enforcement (fail-safe) so deletions are queued for 15m before hard prune (due 2026-05-17). 3) Rachel -> create weekly peering-health report automation for 8w (due 2026-05-01).
diego: I'll ask OrionHealth to schedule a 2hr test window and send a pre-flight checklist. Plan to capture tcpdump + fw logs. Acceptance criteria: no route withdrawal events >3m during tests.
nia: Implementation plan for grace period: add state machine so deletion moves to PENDING with timestamp; controller will only prune if tag mismatch persists > grace_period and backlog < threshold. Emit metric `peering.tag_prune_pending` and alert if >1000. PR draft by 2026-05-01.
sre-mgr: Add regression tests: unit tests for state transition + end-to-end chaos sim in staging that injects BGP flap + high reconciliation backlog. Please include a synthetic Dedicated canary.
eng-bot: CI triggered: branches/nia/grace-period -> build 1294 queued.
rachel: Monitoring: include BGP session uptime, `peering.tag_prune_*` metrics, and per-tenant route counts. Who owns automation?
diego: I'll prototype a lightweight job that queries peering-monitoring every 10m and posts to a dashboard. ETA 3d.
rachel: I'll own the weekly email cadence and add the OrionHealth ops contacts.
ops-bot: Please file JIRA tasks under INC-2026-0523. Reminder: link PRs and RFCs to incident.
nia: RFC posted: https://redwood.internal/rfcs/tag-enforcement-graceperiod (WIP). Feedback welcome.
diego: Short-term mitigations to propose: increase BGP holdtime 120 -> 240 for peering, and temporarily disable SYN-drop policy for peering prefixes. Need ORION approval.
sre-mgr: Also propose a low-effort canary for Dedicated: synthetic cross-account UDP/TCP probes every 2m to detect blackholing faster. Low blast risk.
rachel: Good. Timeline recap and owners: Diego (customer tests & canary prototype) due 2026-05-03 | Nia (grace period + metrics + PR) due 2026-05-17 | Rachel (weekly report + JIRA) due 2026-05-01 | SRE (tests + canary infra) ongoing.
diego: I'll create the JIRA tickets now and tag owners.
eng-bot: JIRA created: INC-2026-0523-1 (Customer BGP window) INC-2026-0523-2 (Grace period feature) INC-2026-0523-3 (Weekly peering report).
rachel: Scheduling a 30m sync next Wed 9am PT to review progress. Please update JIRA before the sync.
ops-bot: Follow-up reminder set for 2026-05-04.
nia: quick note: will add an opt-in env var `PEERING_PRUNE_GRACE=900` so we can toggle per-customer in Dedicated.
rachel: Perfect. Thanks team. Mark this thread as the canonical follow-up; I'll paste these owners into the postmortem doc and ping execs once tasks are in JIRA. :white_check_mark:
